evidence_boundaries: Accessible volume measures forecast breadth, not correctness or human surprise.
HOP remains a rejected deterministic baseline.
Nightingale per-onset distributions are aggregate-only in the saved evidence pack.
Multi-horizon continuation results are exact toy Markov enumerations, not a real language-model benchmark.
Posteriors are conditional on user-supplied likelihoods and are not objective truth scores.
The memory hash chain provides tamper evidence, not authentication.
Cerotto-specific bridge execution was not separately revalidated as part of Zoe.
